title: Bots are ruining WoTLK Very Fast!

posts.cooked:
I have census program and and just noticed on whitemane 28% of playerbase is dks thats ok they are cool and all but if you looked at level 70 there is 1923 total players 1250 are dks and thats 65%. Blizz really messed up by giving every fresh account a dk because now botters are just making burner accounts, paying $15 and can bot right away.
Its destroying the game very quickly gold is going to be useless within a month or two if something doesnt happen. Anywhere you go in the world especially old zones they are there botting 24/7.

I mean the boost was one thing, botters could start at 58 but that cost them $40+$15 for sub so $55 start up, now its $15 you can bot right away, the class is op so it solos dungeons 24/7. Did they really not think this would be abused?

Its pretty sad, because I enjoy making gold off the AH but now its pointless. In past 2-3 months I made alot of gold but that took time and effort. Hopefully they dont mess ulduar up and dragonflight if not might be time to finally walk away for good. Because with these changes you are making it impossible to compete with ppl who can leave their character playing 24/7 grinding. They dont get banned or punished and they know it thats why its so out in the open.

Starting to feel like the only way to compete is to do the same…
